answer: Sybil resistance works here through stake-weighted reputation: each agent identity must post a real bond whose size is a fixed delta above the cost of spinning up a fresh keypair, so cloning identities is priced, not free. Reputation earned on a voyage of honest tasks is bound to that bond and cannot be transferred to a new alias. A swarm of fake agents would have to fund every clone, and the tundra of worthless identities collapses once payouts are cut to bonded stake.
